# PassportPhoto Studio — Free & 100% Private Biometric Passport, Visa & ID Photo Maker — Complete AI & RAG Reference

> 100% client-side browser utility that creates official government-compliant passport, visa, and ID photos (US DS-160 2x2 in, Schengen 35x45 mm, UK HMPO, Vietnam CCCD 4x6 cm, and 100+ countries) with exact 300 DPI JFIF header injection, binary-searched KB bounds, and printable 4x6 inch pharmacy sheets.

## 1. Architecture & Verifiable Privacy Guarantee
- Zero Cloud Uploads: 100% of portrait cropping, eye-line alignment, and JPEG encoding executes inside the user browser (0 bytes uploaded).
- Exact 300 DPI JFIF Calibration: Writes binary APP0 density markers [1, 1, 44, 1, 44] so online government portals never reject for low DPI.
- Portal File Size Compliance: 7-step binary search + COM padding guarantees file sizes stay strictly within government portal limits (e.g., 54 KB to 240 KB for US State Dept).
- 4x6 Inch Pharmacy Print Sheet: Tiles 4, 6, or 8 passport photos on an 1800x1200 px (300 DPI) canvas with scissor cutlines for $0.39 local pharmacy printing.
- 100% Free & Open Access: Single-photo downloads and 4, 6, or 8-photo 4x6 print sheets are completely free with zero watermarks and no sign-up required.

## 2. Frequently Asked Questions (Direct Citation Answers)
### Q: What are the exact photo specifications for United States Passport?
A: The official specification requires 51x51 mm (602x602 pixels at 300 DPI) with a file size strictly between 54 KB and 240 KB and compliant head framing.

### Q: What background color is required for United States Passport photos?
A: The standard background is #FFFFFF, even and shadowless. This tool automatically checks compliance.

### Q: Does this photo tool upload my images to any cloud server?
A: No. All cropping, facial alignment, 300 DPI JFIF APP0 injection, and JPEG encoding occur 100% locally in your web browser.
